plane_flatness_error — ACCEPTANCE evaluate op

• Data kinds: points → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.plane_flatness_error(points, exclude_fraction=0.003) (to call the implementation directly, import acceptance3d; acceptance3d.plane_flatness_error(points, exclude_fraction=0.003); from the registry, opsacceptance.get("plane_flatness_error"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Computes the flatness error F (range of signed distances from the least-squares plane) from the point cloud of a flat (table).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Flatness measurement error F: range of signed distances from the least-squares (orthogonal- regression) plane, after dropping at most floor(exclude_fraction*N) largest deviations and refitting once. Definition as described in Carfagni et al. 2019 for VDI/VDE 2634 Part 2.

★最小二乗の平面(Gauss)であり、最小領域(Chebyshev)の平面ではない。最小領域の F は最小二乗の F 以下になる(定義から)。正弦のうねり(振幅 A、周期の整数倍)を持つ平面では最小二乗の平面が公称の平面と一致し、F = 2A。

返す dict: f、normal (3,)、center (3,)、residual_rms、n_points、n_used、n_excluded。

Raises ValueError: 点が (N, 3) でない・10 点未満・非有限、共線(法線が定まらない)、exclude_fraction が [0, 0.05] の外。
